description.fun: A tiny turtle whose shell only forms and hardens after it hatches, and whose grooved, rounded shape lets it swim at high speed. It sprays foamy water from its mouth with great accuracy. Its English name mixes 'squirt' and 'turtle', a nod to the water guns kids loved, while its Japanese name, Zenigame, says its shell looks like an old coin.
description.guide: A small, light-blue turtle Pokémon whose shell forms and hardens after birth. It withdraws into its shell for protection, swims fast thanks to the shell's streamlined shape and sprays water accurately from its mouth. It is one of the first partner Pokémon of Kanto and evolves into Wartortle.
description.tagline: A pocket-sized turtle with a built-in water gun

description.fun: Wartortle's fluffy tail is a symbol of long life and good luck, which makes it popular with older people, and it's said to live for 10,000 years. The idea comes from a turtle of Japanese legend that lived that long and grew a tail of seaweed. In the water it steers with its furry ears and tail, and it stores air in its fur for long dives.
description.guide: The middle stage of Squirtle's line, a blue turtle Pokémon with feathery ears and a thick, furry tail. It uses its ears and tail to keep its balance while swimming, and its tail is seen as a symbol of long life. It evolves into Blastoise.
description.tagline: A furry-tailed turtle said to live 10,000 years

description.fun: Blastoise is a turtle crossed with a tank: two water cannons slide out of its shell and fire jets that can punch through steel and concrete, and it makes itself heavy to brace against the recoil. It can even fly by jetting water out of the back of its shell. Base Set Blastoise has its own place in card history as the first Pokémon on the English Trading Card Game's test prints.
description.guide: The final stage of Squirtle's line, a large turtle Pokémon with two water cannons on its shell that fire jets strong enough to pierce steel. It makes its body heavy to withstand the recoil and can even propel itself through the air. Blastoise can Mega Evolve into Mega Blastoise and has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A tank of a turtle with water cannons on its shell

description.fun: Its two cannons merge into one giant cannon over its head, with a smaller one on each arm. The main cannon hits as hard as a tank gun and reaches more than 10 km, and stronger legs and back absorb the recoil.
Its shell becomes a battleship bristling with 31 cannons. It's bad at aiming, so it simply overwhelms foes with torrents, and legend says its main cannon can blast holes through mountains.
